summary: Tested L02 LN-020-T01..T03, LN-021-T01/T02 and the LN-022 retest fixes, backend and UI. All 18 existing regression tests pass (test_l02_ln020_ln021 3, ln022_special_price 5, ln022_ln021_extra 4, ln022_form_path_retest 6). I added a new test file with 9 tests, all passing: keep-pending scoping for sales vs sales_admin, a synthetic foreign SO hidden from sales.kanda but visible to salesadmin.kanda, no supplier/owner keys in the pending list, round_down when the long roll comes first in FEFO (still 905/9), exact target producing exact_whole, take_all backorder, and the stock-summary response shape. UI checks after rebuilding the stale static bundle: Sales home KeepPendingPanel (sales-kp-*) shows counts 2/2/1; the pending rows expand to SO -> PR-00005/MKO-00005 + ETA with no supplier names; SalesStockSummary in the kasir quick view shows Fisik/Dikunci/Bebas, 'Datang .. (belum siap kirim) · Menunggu · ATP' and the ATP definition; RollReconcileSheet shows round_up 254,41/5, round_down 204,97/4 and exact_cut options; order-qty shows '51,33 kg (2 roll)' for KSC/SO-00003 and so-compact-qty matches; for salesadmin@ the 'Ajukan Harga Khusus' toggle is visible and the Ubah/Hapus buttons are hidden on SO-bound pending cards.

minor.issue: The requester can delete the only evidence file on a pra that is already submitted (pending). The request returns 200 and leaves a pending request with attachments=[], which bypasses EVIDENCE_REQUIRED from submit. The UI also still shows the trash icon on the attachment chip of SO-bound pending cards, even though Ubah/Hapus are hidden. Reproduced on pra_0ab37a86326f (cleaned up).

When the target equals a whole-roll sum (exact_whole), round_down still drops the shortest roll (905 -> 805/8). This is harmless but noisy; consider omitting round_down when exact_whole exists. round_down/exact_cut may also skip an older FEFO roll (the shortest covering roll), which leaves a small remnant (e.g. a 4,41 yard leftover). This follows the spec, but FEFO is not kept.
st.startswith('in_transit') raises AttributeError if a roll has status None/missing. Use (st or '').

ui_bugs.issue: The same data-testid order-qty-<id> was on both the wrapper div and the inner p (strict-mode selector clash). Fixed: wrapper renamed to order-qty-cell-<id>.

integration_issues.issue: The frontend is served from the static build (static_server.js, NO hot reload). The build at 19:09 was older than the LN-020 source edits (19:45-19:48), so the Sales home KeepPendingPanel was missing until I ran bash /app/scripts/rebuild_frontend.sh. Main agent must rebuild after every frontend edit.

issues: The header 'Tersedia 550 yard' includes group stock while SalesStockSummary shows 'Fisik 0 · Bebas 0 + grup 550'. This can confuse Sales (pre-existing). Consider labelling the header as group stock.
In SalesStockSummary only 'Bebas' has a unit; Fisik/Dikunci/Datang have none.

design_issues.screen: Orders list vs SO compact panel
issues: The list total for KSC/SO-00003 is Rp 2.258.520 (total_amount) but the compact panel Grand Total is Rp 2.506.957 (grand_total incl. PPN). The two numbers are inconsistent (pre-existing).

action_items: Block deleting price-approval attachments once status is pending/approved (or require at least one remaining when EVIDENCE_REQUIRED), and hide the attachment trash icon on SO-bound pending cards.
Always run bash /app/scripts/rebuild_frontend.sh after frontend edits (static bundle, no hot reload).
Optional: omit round_down when exact_whole exists; guard st=None in sales_stock_summary.
critical_code_review_comments: keep_pending router: scoping via sales_ownership.apply_scope is correct (verified with a synthetic foreign SO).
compute_roll_reconcile round_down: picking the shortest roll with length >= excess is correct for the 'largest subset after dropping one roll'. The default up_rolls[-1] is unreachable but safe.
qtyByUnit: groups strictly by unit; never sums yard+kg. OK.
